expect.offline: The trigger carries pinned data in the template (a run of July 2025), which the bench's pin of the same item keeps. Linkup's structured output answers the schema the request sends (a news list) as the response body itself. Each article is stored one at a time (Loop Over Items, batch 1) with a 2 s Wait between; when the loop is done, Aggregate makes one item whose data list counts the stored records for the Slack message. Linkup's fromDate is $now minus 7 days on n8n's unfrozen clock; the fixture does not depend on it.
